services.name: Locked out of the house
services.blurb: You get back inside without a drilled lock, usually with the same key working afterward.

services.name: Keys locked in the car
services.blurb: Door opened with wedge and reach tools, no scratched paint, no broken window glass.

services.name: Frozen or stuck locks
services.blurb: Ice cleared from the cylinder and dry lubricant added so the key turns again tonight.

services.name: Broken key pulled out
services.blurb: The snapped piece comes out of the lock and a new key is cut from it.

services.name: Rekey after moving in
services.blurb: Old keys stop working; your doors take one new key, without buying new locks.

services.name: Deadbolt installed
services.blurb: A solid deadbolt with a reinforced strike and long screws that reach the wall stud.

services.name: Duplex and flat keying
services.blurb: Upper and lower flats each get their own key, with one key for the shared hall.

services.name: Lock repair

services.name: Key copies
services.blurb: House, mailbox and basic car keys cut and tested in your lock before we leave.

reviews.text: Locked myself out of our upper flat at 11 p.m. in January. They said the price range on the phone, texted me the tech's name and a grey van, and he checked my ID before he opened anything. Picked, not drilled. Receipt matched.
reviews.name: Renata W.

reviews.text: Remote start was running and the doors locked with the fob inside. It was about minus eight. The tech had the door open in a few minutes and didn't touch the paint.
reviews.name: Darnell P.

reviews.text: Our side door lock froze solid after a sleet storm. He warmed it, blew the water out and showed me which lubricant to use next time instead of the oil I'd been spraying in there.
reviews.name: Kathy B.

reviews.text: Rekeyed five locks the week we closed, front, back, side, garage entry and the basement door. All on one key now. The price landed inside the range they quoted.
reviews.name: Tomasz L.

reviews.text: We own a duplex in Bay View. He set it up so each unit has its own key and the shared basement takes both. The tenants were happy not to share keys anymore.
reviews.name: Mei S.

reviews.text: Key snapped in the front lock while my hands were full of groceries. Got it out, cut me a new one from the broken halves, done in twenty minutes.
reviews.name: Andre J.
